message.content: {"summary":"You present a coherent reef-monitoring mission, explain its Australian relevance, and use STK visualisations to support a preliminary orbit and ground-control design. To strengthen the report, validate launch feasibility and access results, substantiate whether the orbit meets imaging needs, and quantify end-of-life disposal. Your conclusion and presentation provide a useful foundation but need more critical evaluation and consistency.","next_steps":["In Launch and Orbit, verify the launcher and orbit are compatible and available, explain how launch timing sets RAAN, and support reef revisit and imaging requirements with analysis. Correct the sunlight and coverage claims, and clarify orbital elements for a circular orbit.","In Ground Control & Communications and Mission Duration & EOL, validate the access report’s duplicated and inconsistently ordered entries, justify contact frequency and duration, and estimate drag-sail decay time and disposal compliance. Describe passive decay accurately given the stated lack of thrusters.","In Conclusion and throughout the report, assess whether the design meets mission, data-return, and disposal needs rather than only restating choices. Improve figure/table labelling, grammar, reference completeness and sourcing; include the software files and strengthen claims with reliable evidence."],"criteria":{"C1":"Your Introduction identifies reef monitoring, explains the Australian need, justifies one spacecraft, and names potential users. To strengthen this further, distinguish the operator from customer groups and support the rationale with specific, reliable sources.","C2":"Your Mission Design covers launch, orbit elements, STK access, ground control, mission duration, and EOL. For the next rubric level, substantiate launch feasibility, reef revisit and communications performance with validated evidence, correct the orbit misconceptions, include software files, and quantify disposal.","C3":"Your Conclusion summarises key choices and acknowledges launch uncertainty. To reach the next level, use the evidence to judge whether imaging, data return, and disposal requirements are met, and correct the claim that an SSO provides uninterrupted sunlight.","C4":"Your report has a recognisable structure, executive summary, figures, tables, and bibliography. For the next level, make formatting and labels consistent, improve grammar and caption clarity, complete reference details, and use stronger sources than Wikipedia."}}
